question: The sealift's boarding and sailing; two runs of one new game.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::AssignAreaTargetsAndSealift
addresses.comment: **Which theatre area each land unit is bound for, and the plan's embark and debark.** Read whole on the listing, 0x4C4370 to the `ret 8` at 0x4C7530 (early `ret 8` at 0x4C43B4). One caller, CAIUnit::Tick at VA 0x8B0C38 (answer ignored), for the agent nearest above its unit, daily = (hour == (id+6)%24). Runs when the agent has a unit and (+0x5C is set - cleared here - or daily, or its CEU3AI does not run units). **Nothing at all unless the country owns at least one whole unit of transport capacity** (UnitList_SumTransportCapacity over CCountry +0xBAC >= 1). (1) Areas: the theatre's areas (+0x84) that are real, in order; per area need = EstimateAreaNeed(agent, area, .., relaxed) with relaxed = at war and not COwnerArea_TouchesHostileArea(area), halved (C division) when relaxed and the area is the acting capital's; have = CountDivisionsInArea(.., false) (divisions by Unit_GetAnchorProvince(.,1): target if set, else destination or position). (2) Each unit of +0x11C with a target whose area is real and not one of the theatre's: kept only if army_role 0 and the target is held by a country we CanOperateIn; else target cleared (CArmy +0x2E8 = 0 at once and CSetAIParamCommand(unit, 0, staging) posted) and, a division, counted where it stands. (3) Each theatre area with have > need: repeatedly the division (+0x300 clear) bound there that stands in a theatre area of positive need and is farthest from its target - or, with an embark set, any standing outside embark's area (10000) before those inside it (distance to embark) - is released the same way, until have <= need. (4) Each unit: a target that CAIUnit_MayShipUnitToArea no longer allows is released; one it allows is listed for sealift (weight += definition weight/1000), counting it toward the embark tally when bound for debark and standing in embark's area. A unit with no target standing in our own land outside the theatre's areas (or trespassing anywhere outside) is 'stranded' - a trespasser whose path ends in a friend's land has its target zeroed and is not. (5) Deficit list: per theatre area need-have, our areas sorted largest first (stable; an equal at the head with more provinces goes first), others' areas sorted the same way then pushed in front one by one (so reversed). Per area: want = max(deficit, stranded count where the area is not an enemy's and (touches a hostile area, or is the theatre's largest area, or with no theatre is first)); with want >= 1 the target province is CAIUnit_PickLandingProvince for an enemy-held area, else CAIUnit_PickPortNearestObjectives; then while want >= the next area's deficit (or the area is an enemy's and want > 0) the best unit gets it - CArmy +0x2E8 = province, CSetAIParamCommand(unit, province, staging) - marched with CEU3AI::MoveUnit(.., 0, 1, 1, 0) where CMapProvince::CanUnitReach(province, unit, 1, 1), else listed for sealift. Candidates: no target, anchor area real, CAIUnit_MayShipUnitToArea, not army_role 8 while the agent has air transports, not standing beside an enemy area that also touches the target area, not in a friend's land beside an enemy, own area not still needing it, the headquarters only to the largest area, a division; score = surplus of its own area (+10000 stranded; otherwise only while the deficit is >= 1), + slot 87 (enemy area) or slot 88 by the four touches-war cases (+x, +101-x), + 2 x slot 88 where the target area's +0x3C < 1, +100 where its parent is bound there and +50 per sibling bound there, x2 (CUnit +0x2C9 set) or x0.25 (standing on an ops-area province) where its own area borders an enemy; the strictly highest wins. (6) Every non-division of +0x14C with no target and not a theatre: target = CAIUnit_PickPortNearestObjectives of the area most of its land children stand in, where that is not its own, posted with staging 0 and no move. (7) Tail: +0xD4 = sealift weight; +0x58 = COwnerArea_LargestNavalBase of the theatre's largest area (no theatre: of the unit's area), 0 with no weight. Embark/debark cleared (CSetPlanTransportStateCommand(unit, 0, 0)) when only one is set or both are and nobody bound for debark stands in embark's area. While debark is unset, weight > 0 and the agent has naval transports (+0xEC): votes per listed unit for its target - 1, or 4 where its area's need < 1, +3 where its area holds a played-country objective (never for the AI), +10 where the target is not ours - the strictly best untried target is debark, embark = CAIUnit_PickEmbarkPort of the area (not debark's) where most of the units bound there stand, the strictly largest that yields a port; posted, or the target set aside and the vote repeated. With both set: every listed unit bound for debark standing in embark's area, not aboard, fighting or retreating, adds its weight and is boarded where it stands at embark (0x4D4070) or marched there; transports at embark with no busy order count their transport_capability/1000; while weight > capacity, the transport not at embark, with no blocking order, CUnit::CanMoveTo(embark), organisation >= 0.01, with the lowest ((1-strength)+(1-org))*2+1 times sea distance/1000 is sent (MoveUnit 0,0,0,0); the first idle transport in embark's port then runs 0x4D4D40 or, failing it, 0x4D42D0. Answers whether it posted the pair or moved/boarded anyone. Ghidra's own label on it, CSetAIParamCommand::CSetAIParamCommand_4, is wrong. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-moving.md, section F. **Read again 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 43): logged live, it runs once after a load's second pass with +0x5C set (the constructor's seed). Step 4's embark tally compares embark's area (0x4C59B7) with the area of the unit's destination (GetMovementDestinationProvince, 0x4C5625), or of its province with none (0x4C5630) - stored at [esp+0x48], 0x4C5680 - not where it stands. **Live 2026-11-11** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 50): a unit's sealift weight is its rebuilt definition's +0x10C, so a land brigade of no width under 1.000 organisation - CUnit::RebuildDefinition's reduced path - weighs nothing; Italy's 4a Armata, an hq_brigade at organisation 0 waiting at embark 10731 entering July 1941, counts 0 troops (logged at 0x4C71E3) and no transport is sent. **A transport fleet is sent by CEU3AI::MoveUnit(fleet, embark, 0, 0, 0, 0)** at 0x4C7396 (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 57, read 2026-11-12) - before the tick's naval body, which then finds it bound. **Read 2026-11-12** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 59): an own area's record with the head's deficit and more provinces (+0x2C) than the head's area goes in front (0x4C5AF1), else the sorted insert 0x4DD740; the fill writes CArmy +0x2E8 at 0x4C6484 (unit EAX, province ESI); a transport fleet is sent at 0x4C7396. **The fill's comparison, logged 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 61): at 0x4C63E6 the candidate's score is a single (XMM0, kept at [esp+0x3C]), the best a single at [esp+0x54], the unit at [esp+0x5C]; x2 for a garrison (0x4C63A6) and x0.25 (0x4C63DA) go through double; the x0.25 asks the agent's area of operations (+0x90/+0x94) for the province at [esp+0x28], the unit's anchor - its destination, else where it stands - not where it stands. **The debark vote, logged 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 62): the votes are a stdext::hash_map<int,int> on the stack at [esp+0xE8], each added through HashMapIntInt_Subscript (0x4DD0A0) at 0x4C6BB3; the walk (0x4C6BF6, target EDX, votes ESI, best EDI) compares the count first and asks the tried list ([esp+0xA0]) only then. The map's list order: eight buckets by hash_compare's scramble, an empty bucket's key at the end, any other into its bucket's run ascending. **Boarding and sailing, measured 2026-11-13** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 63): a transport at embark whose troops board in a pass is sent on its way in the same pass - Britain's Ceylon Command aboard at Colombo and the squadron's path to debark set within the hour, in both runs of a new game.
addresses.evidence: Two runs of the same new game, hourly saves and one at 4 January 12:00, set beside each other and OpenHOI3's.
